harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.name: reborn-short-gold-4db-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-23: borg-reborn-rs owner ("file the zoo pilots"; re-pinned to 4db877c6 after the re-review), borg-zoo#723; zoo owner, 2026-11-23: "yes do all" (the pilot at the new pin).
experiment.prespecified: Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#723; borg-reborn-rs #828, PR #854 at the re-pin 4db877c6; the pilot at b8605b5c, run 45117521981, was on the previous pin and does not carry over). Two arms: ctl (town_short_gold 0, shipped) and shortgold (town_short_gold 1). Pilot: classes-18, 100,000 turns, evidence retained, 36 cells. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; whether the shopping order and the oil use act as intended. Read, per class and paired start, at the first departure from town and at the first dangerous encounter at CL 1-3: healing potions, Phase Door, usable ranged options and throwable oil apart from fuel; purchase counts and gold spent; for Grip, Fang and other early dangerous encounters the oil carried at contact, whether held oil was used and how the fight or escape ended; deaths at CL 1-3 and all deaths, paired (rescued, newly killed, identical plays), max CL and DL, stalls and missing cells. At a control death rate near 2% the counts are reported without strong conclusions. Then, only if the pilot shows the policy acts as intended: the small tier. Every value is a hypothesis; descriptive (RULES 14).
experiment.question: On borg-reborn-rs 4db877c6 (PR #854 after its re-review: a rod still recharging no longer covers the ranged need, oil always scored beside the ordinary throw), does short-gold shopping with held oil (town_short_gold 1, #828) change what the Borg carries at its first departure and at its first dangerous encounter at CL 1-3, and its early deaths?
